answer: An identity earns its seat through hiccup acoustic signature, a proof that is cheap to make once and ruinous to fake at scale. An honest agent spends 14 minutes once; the operator of 379 fakes spends 5306 minutes per epoch, forever, which prices the farm out. What carries the zephyr here is verification, the beacon of cost is what stops the farm, and the lantern of the record keeps every claim checkable. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
